**Filter 10** `0x4b2b50` (entry 2.27) [verified: code `0x4b2b50`–`0x4b2bb8`]: its own naked entry does the exe's `mov eax, 0x100000; call _chkstk` (`0x5d2080`, through `ZAX_ASM_CODE_ATT`, so the standalone exe takes its function table's entry) and passes the frame's base as the histogram, which the exe has at `[esp + 8]` after its two pushes. On a stack with less than 1 MB free below the call the probe ends in a stack overflow, as in the original; until now the histogram was on the heap.

**The multiplayer game type without a match state** [verified: code, e.g. `0x51c25f`–`0x51c261`]: every user fetches the state again (slot 97 +0x30, the inlined class getter, IsKindOf) and dereferences it without a test: null or an object of another class reads a byte at 8 (`EndMatch` `0x51c650`, `PlayerReady` `0x51c800`, the end of a match from `Update`/`AddTeamScore`), a qword at 0x10 (`MatchTime` `0x51c1f0`, `Update` `0x51c310`) or writes one there (`SetMatchTime` `0x51c270`). The source's `game_data()` returned null there, and clang took the following dereference as proof of a non-null pointer: in the build before, the null test and IsKindOf's answer were gone (IsKindOf called on null, then the field of whatever object was at +0x30 read) [verified: `llvm-objdump` of `mp_game_type.o` before]. An empty `asm("" : "+r"(d))` now hides the null, and the compiled code tests, calls IsKindOf, and reads `[0 + 0x10]` (`fldl 0x10(%ecx)` with ecx 0) or writes it (`fstpl 0x10(%ecx)`) as the exe [verified: `llvm-objdump`]. The same barrier keeps filter 10's slot 58 on a frame the class test refused. [assumption: other places of the source where a C++ dereference follows a null path may have been compiled the same way; not audited here.]

**What stays different** [verified: code]: the slots, the order of the reads and writes and the use are the exe's; the bytes found in a slot are what the earlier calls left there. In kind o they are the exe's own history; where earlier callees are reimplemented (in part in kind h, everywhere in kind x) their frames differ, so the garbage can differ. The faults: same exception, access kind and address; the faulting instruction is the reimplementation's, and in kinds h and x the overflowing probe is the reimplemented `_chkstk` (`crt_math.cpp`, the same instructions). Found and not changed (`docs/ORIGINAL_BUGS.md`, "Not reproduced"): `rle16.cpp`'s unreachable remap table (0), `resource_fields.cpp`'s `pack_data` marker (an uninitialised C++ local, not at the exe's address), `0x4f8b00`'s position and the other block readers' locals (not reviewed).

**Port note** (for `zax-redone`): the naked entries, the check helpers' assembly and `ZAX_ASM_CODE_ATT` are i386 (cdecl bodies with `_` names, ecx as this); the 64-bit and Mac builds need portable variants of these nine functions and of filter 10 (the 1 MB stack array overflows only where the thread's stack is that small). The null match state's barrier is plain C++ with an empty asm and carries over; address 8/0x10 faults on every target.

**The checks** (new cases; side 0 the original, side 1 the reimplementation, each called through `zax_call_stack`/`zax_call_filled` of `check_util.cpp`, which write a fill of the case below the stack pointer and call, so both sides find the same bytes in their uninitialised slots; `fill_index` names the fill's dword at an exe slot):
- `field_text`: `ColorField_FromText` on 12 texts without red, green or blue, 240 cases: eax, the colour and that red and green are the fill's bytes at the exe's `[esp + 4]`/`[esp]`. `Pixel16_FromRGB` `0x433a10` is replaced by a recorder there: with the game's tables built a garbage channel or the text pointer as blue indexes them far outside and ended the game in the first run (the original's behaviour as well).
- `world_update`: Bounce 300 cases, the sweep reporting half its hits without the part, the part hit recorded raw and checked against the fill's dword (24 of 24 from the slot); SendSound 400 cases, the channel dword whole and eax whole (442 of 442 upper bytes the fill's).
- `field_objects`: the array readers on up to 40 real descriptors with a fake name list (one name, Find records and answers -1), an empty stream (the count from the fill: 0, 1, 2, 0x1234) and a name length beyond the stream (the buffer the fill's); 210 and 240 cases.
- `object_table`: `ReadLocationBinary` on 30 streams cut after the header, the position, the magic, the count and one ID, with the location known in some (eax the fill's); the position from the fill kept inside the stream (the exe's memory stream is not read past its end by the test).
- `c4_fields`: the colour's binary read on 0–2 bytes; `c4_net`: the explosion and sound readers, 48 cases, the bool and the channel recorded whole.
- `mp_game_type`: 120 cases of `Update`, `AddTeamScore`, `MatchTime`, `SetMatchTime`, `EndMatch`, `PlayerReady` with +0x30 null or the game type object (another class), through `call_faulting` (a vectored handler records the exception and leaves the call like `zax_escape_exit`; the FPU is restored after a fault, the first runs showed the faulting `fld` left a value on the FPU stack): 188 faults, every one 0xc0000005 below 0x18 with the same access and address on both sides.
- `raster_rest`: filter 10 also on a thread with a 1 MB stack reserve (`call_faulting_on_thread`): 30 of 30 calls 0xc00000fd on both sides.
- **Positive control** (the DLL with these checks and the production code before the batch, `Assimilate Cave1`, `20261112-085016-7bdc`): every new case differs — the colour 200 of 240, the arrays 175 of 210, Bounce 301 of 301, SendSound 133 of 401, the readers 24 of 48, the colour's binary read 60 of 1434, the location reader 27 of 858, the match state 84 of 121, filter 10 16 of 121 (no overflow on the old side).

**Runs** (x86, 2026-11-12; DLL SHA-256 `9b246c82…` (before `824ee4e8…`), exe `358818a1…` (before `f8872a83…`), each built twice the same; outputs in the workspace's `runs/faithful2/`):
- Builds: rc 0, only the warnings of the build before (`PIOINFO_END`, `set_help`, `ISCTYPE`, `ZAX_MENU_LAUNCHER_SITE`, `MAIN_MENU_CALL`); the code of exactly 8 production objects changed (`c4_fields c4_net field_objects field_text mp_game_type object_table raster_rest world_update`) [verified: `llvm-objdump -d -r` of all objects of both builds].
- The touched modules and the ones whose checks call these functions (`c4_fields c4_net field_text world_update field_objects object_table object_io object_files mp_game_type raster_rest entity_classes weapon_world`), all cases: `Assimilate Cave1` `20261112-084446-b353`, `Test/Nachbau1` `-084456-20c7`, 64 of 64 the same each, `All checks done`.
- All modules, `CheckScale=0.1`: `Assimilate Cave1` `20261112-085309-b65b`, `Test/Nachbau1` `-085309-9037`, 1177 of 1177 the same each (1171 before and six new), `All checks done`.
- Replays, kinds h and x against the recording runs (the exe the final one; the DLL of a build whose production objects are the final one's, only `check_util.o` and `checks_object_table.o` differ [verified: `llvm-objdump`] for `v6` and `saves`, the final DLL for the rest): `v6` 16 plays 32 of 32 (`20261112-084407-64f9` … `-092140-7c1c`), `saves` (sv011, sv041, sv101) 6 of 6 (`-084241-587c` … `-084916-9640`), `gaps-sp` 10 plays 20 of 20 (`-092354-2227` … `-093724-6c16`), `gaps-world` 4 plays 8 of 8 (`-092332-26c0` … `-093325-465d`), `gaps-ui` 4 plays 8 of 8 (`-092354-294b` … `-093500-5c34`), all the same (frames, saves).
- Shot set (filter 10 is a drawing path), the final DLL (`20261112-090053-c719` … `-091202-a2eb`) and exe (`-091340-4737` … `-091925-94fa`): 9 of 9 scenes identical or different only in their animated areas each.
- Not run: ARM, XP, the LAN sets, the other sets and display modes, the final check, a play that reaches filter 10 or a null match state in the game (no known path does) [assumption: from the sources; not searched further].
